name: jph-zig-voice-agent
description: Vodafone Ziggo AI Voice Support demonstration agent — hub-and-spoke multi-agent, audio modality, en-GB/nl-NL bilingual.

variableDeclarations.name: customer_profile
variableDeclarations.description: JSON object containing customer identity: customer_id, first_name, last_name, account_status, is_default_persona. Set by before_agent_callback from recognize_customer result or default persona fallback. NEVER override in evals.

variableDeclarations.name: active_language
variableDeclarations.description: Active conversation language. One of: 'English', 'Dutch'. Default 'English'. Updated by update_language tool on explicit switch request.

variableDeclarations.name: _escalation_trigger
variableDeclarations.description: Internal trigger for deterministic escalation. Set by set_escalation_trigger tool (LLM detection). Read and cleared by before_model_callback (execution). One of: 'escalate', ''. NEVER set in evals.

variableDeclarations.name: _silence_count
variableDeclarations.description: Consecutive silence/no-input event count. Incremented by before_model_callback on root_agent. Reset to 0 when user speaks. Session ends after 3 consecutive silences.
